file_note: Study file in the jev-actions thresholds.json shape (`decisions[]` entries use internal/decisions/thresholds field names) plus a `study` block holding the preregistered decision rules. It is NOT Scout's `.scout/decisions/thresholds.json` override (Scout's loader rejects unknown top-level keys); it is never copied there. Tuned values are written per round to data/rounds/<r>/thresholds.json by tune.py, not into this frozen file.

minimums.provenance: assumed: council default (design Appendix 19 defaults; X3 rev 2.1 value for P_assign) accepted by the user 2026-10-29 (shape-decision, user decision 6); P_new / R_new are no longer minimums of the verdict (user decision 2026-10-30, R-051; council round 4 R4-13)
minimums.cost_asymmetry: a silent wrong-area assignment costs more than a spurious new-area suggestion (it mislabels issues and nothing flags it; a pooled new area is visible and mergeable)
minimums.resolved_definitions: a cluster is resolved when the primary arm's composed output is assigned or none, abstained when it is unresolved for any reason (below_t_cov / below_t_choice, permutation_disagreement, failure); P_assign = assigned-correct / assigned (a wrong assignment on a gold-none positive counts); R_assign here is R_assign_res = assigned-correct / (gold-covered AND resolved), a false none on a covered cluster counting as a resolved wrong answer; R_assign over all gold-covered clusters (abstention = miss) is reported beside it; the 0.80 new-area bound survives only as x2d.NEW_AREA_GATE_MIN, the round-0 planted-new / P2 gate bound, not a verdict condition

decisions.cost_rule: a false `covered` sends the cluster to a Choice that must then pick some area (a possible silent wrong assignment) so the provisional threshold is 0.7 (jev-actions: 0.7 when a false action costs more); tuned from saved scores of earlier rounds once a label has >= 30 cases
assumptions: tuned on score = 1 - p_true with label 1 = gold none (the P_new / R_new minimums apply to detecting new)
t_cov provisional 0.7 until >= 30 cases per label (round-0 D and P units count as dev cases)

decisions.cost_rule: a silent wrong assignment costs more than an unresolved cluster, so F-beta with beta 0.5 and a provisional 0.7
assumptions: score = top-option probability; label 1 = the top option is in the cluster's acceptable set; precision = correct / assigned, recall = correct / gold-covered (P_assign, R_assign)
a cluster asked under two permutations is assigned only if both agree; the tuned score is the mean confidence of the two
label 1 = the area is in the cluster's acceptable set; tuned per (cluster, area) pair
contested/unowned onboarding files are few; the threshold stays provisional through the pilot and onboarding quality is reported, not gated, apart from the round-0 gates of PREREGISTRATION section 5

decisions.cost_rule: report-only duplicate check; no behaviour reads a threshold
assumptions: duplicate flag rule is p_true >= 0.7 in both presentation orders (reported figure, not gating)

tuning.tool: tune_threshold.py of the jev-actions skill, run per decision on the saved scores.csv of rounds < r only (and the round-0 D and P units); stratified 5-fold cross-validation, `--seed 20261029`
tuning.below_30_cases_per_label: provisional threshold 0.7 (cost rule above); no tuning
tuning.30_to_50_cases_per_label: tune, status provisional, `--repeats 5 --conservative`, reported as noisy
tuning.over_50_cases_per_label: tune; ready iff > 50 cases per label, every fold tuned, fold thresholds within 0.05, no 0.5 replacement, composed dev minimums met (dev P_assign, dev R_assign_res and the dev unresolved rate <= 0.15; dev P_new / R_new are recorded, not enforced; R1-25, R4-13 (4))
forbidden: tuning on the scores of the round being scored
relaxing a minimum silently (if no threshold meets the minimums, report that)
tuning.split: round r units are `test` for round r's scoring and `dev` for every later round's tuning; the frozen rounds 8-10 are `test` only and never feed tuning

study.units: residual clusters (PREREGISTRATION section 3), at most pr_cap scored per PR

informative_round.kappa_basis: joint answer (none / area with acceptable-overlap mapped to one label) over the GO population (the scored non-control units of the round, core-gate units excluded), A vs B labellers before adjudication; kappa over all non-control scored units is reported as kappa_answer_all_units; kappa on `covered`, raw agreement and prevalence are reported and decide nothing (R1-06, R3-10, R4-12)

intervals.pooled: PR-cluster bootstrap (B = 10000, seed 20261029): one-sided 90 % for e, 95 % for the guard h (gain_guess); condition b is the one-sided 90 % Wilson lower bound of the pooled P_assign (verdict.json p_assign_bootstrap is reported and decides nothing)
intervals.paired: exact McNemar on discordant clusters + PR-cluster bootstrap

study.descriptive_rule: point minimums met in >= 3 of the last 4 informative rounds (reported; decides nothing)

futility.rule: three consecutive informative rounds in which the pooled paired gain on resolved clusters (gain_res: Jev correct - B2 correct over the clusters where Jev is assigned or none, pooled over the three rounds, PR-cluster bootstrap) has an 80 % upper bound <= +0.02 AND the pooled P_assign has an 80 % upper bound below the P_assign minimum
futility.no_unresolved_rate_disjunct: there is no futility disjunct on the unresolved rate u: u is under the refinement menu's direct control (thresholds) and a stop on it would stop what refinement exists to fix; u and gain_all are reported in the futility table (R4-13 (5))
futility.effect: stop the refinement rounds; the frozen rounds are not run; verdict NO-GO (futility)
futility.integrity_pause_note: an integrity pause is not evidence against HD6 and does not count towards futility; cap breach = a round whose wide labels cannot be completed within its session cap, also after a recorded clarification: the round stops, it is reported, the council and the user decide in a new review round (R4-02); a clarify pre-check refusal is recorded in rounds/R/clarify-refused.json and treated like a recorded revision

go.evaluated: once, on the pooled frozen rounds 8-10, after all three are scored and labelled; GO population = scored, non-control, no core_gate; resolved = the primary arm's output is assigned or none, abstained = unresolved for any reason; user decision 2026-10-30 (R-051), council round 4 R4-13
go.guard: one-sided 95 % PR-cluster-bootstrap lower bound of gain_guess > 0 (every GO-population cluster with a B2 outcome; an abstained cluster is scored by Jev's own unthresholded guess; a missing raw answer is wrong); fails -> INCONCLUSIVE
all_of: b. P_assign one-sided 90 % Wilson lower bound >= 0.80
c. R_assign_res point >= 0.80 (assigned-correct / (gold-covered AND resolved); a false none on a covered cluster counts)

d. paired gain on resolved clusters gain_res = (Jev correct - B2 correct) / n_res, the same resolved clusters for both arms (Jev-abstained clusters are excluded from the pair, not scored as wrong for Jev), point >= +0.10
e. gain_res one-sided 90 % PR-cluster-bootstrap lower bound > 0 (per-PR rows over resolved clusters only)
f. the resolved clusters where Jev is correct and B2 is not come from >= 3 distinct PRs
g. unresolved rate u = abstained / GO population <= 0.15 (the cap; a point condition)

h. abstention guard: the one-sided 95 % PR-cluster-bootstrap lower bound of gain_guess = (sum of guess-correct - sum of B2-correct) / n_all > 0, where an abstained cluster is scored by the primary arm's own unthresholded combined answer (none iff raw_covered is False, else raw_choice; a missing raw answer is wrong) and a resolved cluster by its composed answer (R5-01)

j. perception check passes: V-sem's UNTHRESHOLDED combined answer (none iff not raw_covered, else raw_choice) agrees with the consensus label within 0.10 of labeller-vs-labeller agreement, whatever the primary arm is; the thresholded agreement, the unresolved rate and the primary arm's agreement are reported and decide nothing (the >= 20 units with both questions final of PREREGISTRATION section 8)

k. shuffled-catalogue null N1 (the Choice follows option text, not position or id; P1 is the path-cue test): on D union P (>= 40 gold-covered units planned) Jev accuracy under permuted titles/summaries and no sample files has a 90 % Wilson upper bound <= max(2/K, 0.20), K the catalogue size (run in round 0, reported again)
l. every frozen round informative (>= 20 scored clusters, >= 6 PRs, kappa >= 0.6 on the GO population, labels-check not failed)
go.removed_conditions: P_new, R_new and 'real gold-none positives >= 10' are no longer conditions of the verdict
go.reported_beside_the_verdict: u with its per-reason split (below_t_cov, below_t_choice, permutation_disagreement, failure) and per round; the abstention table (n abstained; B2 accuracy on Jev-abstained, Jev-resolved and all clusters); gain_guess with its point, 95 % bound, 95 % CI and McNemar; gain_all (every abstention a miss) with its 90 % bound and McNemar; P_new / R_new on real and on planted positives with Wilson 95 % ('n real positives; no veto'); R_assign over all covered clusters (abstention = miss) beside R_assign_res; leave-one-round-out figures
go.b2_pairing: a case enters the resolved pair iff the primary arm's output is assigned or none and B2 has a scored outcome; B2's own unresolved (a B0/B2 tie) stays a measured wrong answer for B2; per-PR pooling rows carry n_res, d_res, a, ac, gc_res, gc, n_all, d_all, d_guess, abst, abst_b2_correct

study.inconclusive: evaluated after the not-informative test: a frozen round that is not informative (condition l) gives INCONCLUSIVE before any point test; then, with every point condition (a, c, d, g) passing, a bound (b, e), the >= 3-PR spread (f), the abstention guard (h) or n_res >= 50 (i) fails, or perception / N1 is unmeasured; reasons name each failed condition (h: Jev shows no accuracy edge over B2 once its abstentions are answered by its own unthresholded guess; the resolved-cluster gain may be selection)
study.no_go: after the informativeness test: a point condition (a, c, d or g) fails (g, the unresolved-rate cap, is a measured product failure), or perception or N1 was measured and failed, or futility (three consecutive informative refinement rounds). Precedence: not informative -> INCONCLUSIVE; point fails -> NO-GO; measured perception/N1 fail -> NO-GO; all twelve pass -> GO; else INCONCLUSIVE (R1-19, R4-13)
study.pre_run_stop: a P3 power cell below its bar on the live structure, or any frozen round with < 20 clusters or < 6 PRs, is not a verdict cause: the council and the user decide before any spend, and a recorded user_decision: proceed in the round-0 critique lets the pilot run, otherwise it is not run; a NULL power cell (N3, N3_PR, N4a, N4b, N4b_cap, N4b_rho0) above its bar on the live structure is a stop no user_decision clears (the GO rule is unsound there: new council round; power_sim exits 3) (R3-16, R4-08, R4-13 (7), R4-12, R5-02)
study.new_area: P_new / R_new reported with Wilson 95 % on real positives and on planted positives; no veto. Planted figures (verdict.json pooled.planted_new, R5-07) come from the frozen rounds' empty-file rename traps (one per round): R_new = (arm none AND gold not covered) / gold not covered, P_new = (arm none AND gold not covered) / arm none, gold-conditioned, both over traps with gold and an arm row (a trap lacking either is unmeasured); the round-0 planted new concern and the P2 gap gate are in rounds/0/gates.json

power.bars_note: P3 cells: GO share >= bar (binding); N3, N3_PR, N4a, N4b, N4b_cap, N4b_rho0: GO share <= bar in every cell (binding; N4b_cap = own-error abstention truncated at the cap, p in {0.80, 0.85}, rho 0.5; N4b_rho0 = own-error abstention at rho 0, p in {0.85, 0.88, 0.90}); a P3 cell below its bar needs a user_decision, a null cell above its bar stops the pilot; council rounds 4 R4-13 (6) and 5 R5-01 / R5-02; the drafter does not move a bar

study.go_meaning: licenses a full trial (>= 2 repositories, dev/test by repository), not adoption; a GO leads to a design round (governance acknowledgement, shape-decision user decision 7)

caps.cli_sessions_note: the cap of each round is cap_r = ceil(1.25 x (2.2 W_r (1 + C_r) + 4.4 J_r + R_r + 2.2 I_r)) with hard ceiling cli_sessions_ceiling, W_r wide-labelled units (scored + audit + control + contrast-window; round 0: D + P + controls + contrast-D), C_r = 1 when the round has its one recorded guide clarification (its re-label is budgeted, a clarification that would not fit is refused before it is recorded and rounds/R/clarify-refused.json is written, R4-02) else 0, J_r = 20 perception units, R_r = 20 reference sessions, I_r intruder items; the computed cap and used count are written to results.json (PREREGISTRATION 12, R1-05, R3-01); the v_7 re-score spend is charged to the $10 total only (R3-17); a round whose wide labels cannot be completed within its cap is the integrity pause 'cap breach' (not counted towards futility)
caps.jev_cost_stop: the X2c -max-cost-usd stop, cumulative over the append-only output; a re-run refuses to start once the file's spend exceeds the cap
